illustration.description: Realistic semi-illustrated side view of a human leg with a white ankle sock, stepping into a black low-top athletic sneaker with white thick rubber midsole and a black pull tab loop at the heel. A translucent, glowing view shows the foot's toes pushing against the front of the shoe, with the toe area blurred and tinted warm peach/skin tone, and a few short red motion tick marks near the toes indicating pressure or pain. Clean white studio background with a soft shadow beneath the shoe, detailed fabric texture, laces, soft even lighting, polished digital illustration style.

graphics.description: Three short red motion/pain tick marks radiating from the toe area of the shoe, indicating pressure
Dashed horizontal grey line running across the bottom of the slide
Grey open arrowhead at the right end of the dashed line pointing right, acting as a next/continue indicator
